# Cappadocia audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/cappadocia-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set cappadocia` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `burner.mp3` is cut from "Hot air balloon burner" by YannSauvin, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/YannSauvin/sounds/778358/.
- `valley.mp3` is cut from "Dagestan, Urakhi village, morning ambience, XY stereo.wav" by gladkiy, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/gladkiy/sounds/363823/.
